title: Standard Gaussian density decay at negative infinity
statement: Let $\varphi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be the standard Gaussian density. As $x$ tends to negative infinity, $\varphi(x)$ tends to $0$.
replaced: Let $\varphi(x)=e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}$ be the standard Gaussian density. Its limit at negative infinity is $\lim_{x\to-\infty}\varphi(x)=0$.
